messages:
sasha: Quick sync 1 opened a short docs PR to add a compatibility walkthrough for the new quota header names and dashboard mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5314

nate: Thanks! Can we show a tiny before/after snippet for curl + python-sdk? People copy paste the first thing they see.

sasha: Yep 1 added both. Before: `curl -H 'X-Redwood-Tier: bronze' ...` After: `curl -H 'x-redwood-quota: bronze' ...` Python snippet uses `client.request(..., headers={'x-redwood-quota':'bronze'})`.

claire: Heads up: proxies and some load balancers downcase headers. Recommend lowercase examples and an explicit tip about canonicalization.

sasha: Good call, updated examples to lowercase and added an inline callout: "Tip: use lowercase header names to avoid proxy-induced mismatches."

ben: For dashboards: can we include the exact PromQL example that maps tier assignments? I added a comment in the PR suggesting `sum by (tier) (increase(billing.tier_assigned[7d]))`. Also suggest a plain-English line explaining the result.

sasha: Added the query and a line: "This returns the number of times each tier was assigned over the last 7 days; use it to verify mappings after migration."

nate: One more nuance: Dedicated customers' quota math is different (reserve then burst). I added a short parenthetical and tagged eng for confirmation of the metric name used for reserve. @ben can you confirm if `billing.reserve_used` exists?

ben: Confirmed with eng in #eng-runtime: metric is `billing.dedicated_reserve_used`. I added a small note and a link to the Dedicated metrics table.

claire: Also include a short checklist at the top: 1) Pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2) Update header names, 3) Run end-to-end smoke with staging dashboard open. That made migrations easier last time.

sasha: Added checklist and a yellow deprecation banner for legacy headers. Docs-bot: can you make a deploy preview?

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-5314--docs.redwood.ai/quota/compat (preview expires in 7 days).

nate: Quick manual check on staging looks fine. Merging in 5m unless anyone objects.

sasha: Thanks team! I'll follow up with a tiny PR that drops the small dashboard thumbnail and a short example of how tier changes affect monthly billing estimates.
